lead_verification: LEAD RE-VERIFICATION (supersedes an earlier, mistaken lead downgrade). CONFIRMED on Chou2011: n_lo 1 vs 1, r_s_ratio 0.121797044 vs 0.122, order-1 Fourier 0.989489354 vs 0.989, order-2 increment 0.009206 vs 0.009. ALSO CONFIRMED on the Weinreich landscape: averaging the ten four-locus faces of the five-locus landscape, which is the procedure the record states, reproduces 0.893835535 / 0.063756852 / 0.106164465 against the printed 0.894 / 0.064 / 0.106. An earlier lead check wrongly ran the whole five-locus landscape and got 0.918275, and wrongly accused the record of a column mis-mapping; the record correctly identifies the third column as Fsum, the total epistatic fraction 1 - F1, not an order-3 term.
